verdict.summary: Fitch revised Uzbekneftegaz's outlook to Positive (Nov-2026) and upgraded its SCP to b+ (from b), reflecting cumulative 67% regulated gas tariff hikes in 2026, ~$1bn in state support, and 2025-26 dividend exemptions. LTM mid-2026 EBITDA reached ~$1.5bn with net leverage dropping from ~3.1x to 2.2x ahead of Nov-2028 ($700m) and May-2030 ($850m) maturities.

positives: Fitch Nov-26 Positive outlook & SCP upgrade to b+ driven by 67% 2026 domestic gas tariff reform.
Deleveraging to 2.2x net debt/EBITDA (from 3.1x) on ~$1.5bn LTM EBITDA plus ~$1bn state support & dividend waivers.
Equalized with Uzbekistan sovereign (BB Positive at Fitch) as strategic 100% state oil & gas operator.
negatives: Structural decline in mature domestic gas fields requiring ongoing drilling/GTL capex.
Fitch forecasts medium-term leverage settling back toward 3x-4x if capex accelerates or state support normalizes.
S&P lags at BB- Stable (one notch below Fitch).

background.ownership_governance: 100% Republic of Uzbekistan (Ministry of Economy & Finance); LSE-listed Eurobonds.
